correctness.rationale: The depth-one least-squares coefficient was re-derived and the exact rational recurrence independently replayed. At \(\varepsilon=1/200\), iterates one through five have both coordinates positive, while the sixth has second coordinate \(-4801559852330482770906299820259/349417867959904066964567555052100\), with positive first coordinate. The scaled limiting recurrence has nonzero least-squares denominators and a strictly negative limiting sixth second coordinate, so rational dependence gives an open small-\(\varepsilon\) family. In one dimension the first accelerated residual can be annihilated exactly and the iterate lands at the positive fixed point.

value.rationale: This is a motivated boundary result for an accelerator routinely applied to positive variables. It isolates a genuine multivariate cone-invariance failure even for a decoupled positive strict contraction, proves dimension two is minimal in the stated affine class, and provides an exact regression witness for safeguard design.
residual_risks: The family approaches contraction factor one and does not determine a universal sharp safety threshold.
